send_at.description: The time at which to send the campaign, in RFC3339 format

from_email.description: The email address from which the campaign will be sent. It should be from a verified domain from your Paubox Marketing settings page

from_name.description: The name to appear as the sender of the campaign

sender_email.description: The email address of the person/entity sending this email. Should be a Paubox user email address and is NOT going to appear as the From email

subscription_list_id.description: The uuid of the subscription list to which the campaign will be sent

subject.description: The subject line of the campaign mailing

dynamic_list_id.description: The uuid of the dynamic list to which the campaign will be sent (optional)

recipient_emails.description: A list of extra recipient email addresses for the campaign to be sent to. These are not tracked for analytics purposes and are usually just for verification and/or testing
